banner.title: calibre-web-automated
banner.tagline: Imports ebooks from the NAS ingest folder into a Calibre library and serves that library as a web reader.

explainer.title: Ingest folder in, Calibre library out

steps.title: Ingest
steps.text: Books land in the NFS ingest folder on the NAS, written by the book download pipeline. CWA watches the folder and starts each import.
steps.scene: a book dropping into a tray from a download arrow

steps.title: Import
steps.text: CWA adds each book to the Calibre library on the NAS. That library sits on NFS and is not part of the kopiur snapshot.

steps.title: Read
steps.text: The web reader serves the library on envoy-internal, at the calibre route.
steps.scene: an open book beside a browser window

steps.title: Metadata
steps.text: Goodreads and Hardcover tokens come from items goodreads and hardcover, through one Secret.
steps.scene: a key unlocking a book cover

steps.title: Keep
steps.text: kopiur snapshots the 20 GiB config claim to R2 each day. The ingest and library folders stay on the NAS.
steps.scene: snapshot cards flowing into a cloud bucket
